contentText:
Kehlani’s “Folded” and Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” slip a spot, but can Bruno Mars’ comeback single “I Just Might” sweep the No. 1 throne from Taylor Swift?

Tetris Kelly:

Is Bruno’s comeback single enough to dethrone Taylor Swift’s “Fate”? This is the Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 for the week dated January 24th. Taylor’s “Opalite” is at 10. “Folded” falls to No. 9. Sombr is locked at eight. “End of Beginning” slips to seven. As does “Choosin’ Texas” to six. And “Ordinary” down to No. 5. “Man I Need” stays put at four.
